obligations.title: Maintain security controls aligned to ISO 27001.
Process personal data only on Customer's documented instructions and per data protection law.
Execute a Data Processing Agreement before any personal data is processed.
Return or securely delete all Customer Data within 30 days of termination or expiry.
Certify deletion of Customer Data in writing.
Keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential for 3 years after the Agreement ends.
